headline: BMW reveals new details for the electric i3 sedan
standfirst: The automaker is finally sharing specs on its upcoming Neue Klasse electric vehicle.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: BMW shared new details about its revamped i3 sedan. It now expects a range of up to 468 miles.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: BMW previously announced the i3 would move to its new Neue Klasse platform. Initial reveals lacked

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Range anxiety is a major hurdle for EV buyers. High mileage figures could make this a strong competitor.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: The company has yet to confirm the final price. Keep an eye out for official pricing announcements.

caption:
BMW has released more information about the upcoming electric i3 sedan and its expected range.

The German automaker is slowly filling in the gaps about this four-door model built on the Neue Klasse platform. While we still do not have a final price, the 468-mile range estimate is a significant update for potential buyers. We are waiting to see how the final sticker price compares to other EVs.
